scene_purpose: Let Torren Harth materially demonstrate why Maevra sought him by leading the party from Greenhollow toward Hollow Watch without using the obvious occupied route; visually establish the small cliff-side Yahtrean fort, Black Host occupation, excavation activity, and older buried construction before the party enters; preserve later revelations without making the characters repeatedly verbalize knowledge limits.

scene_context_seed.location_name: Greenhollow north edge → Hollow Watch spur / old watch trail → approach overlook
visible_environment: the obvious watch road climbs directly toward the occupied fort and is avoided
Torren uses a less direct approach route and adjusts to current ground as he goes
Hollow Watch appears as a small Yahtrean cliff-side fort under established Black Host occupation
digging gear, spoil, winches, scaffolding and supply movement make active excavation visually clear
older buried masonry is exposed beneath or beside the later Yahtrean fort construction
scene_context_seed.runtime_note: Rehearsal-first rule applies. Torren is actively leading the party, so limited moving dialogue is legal only when it belongs to actual guidance or an immediate route event. Most traversal remains gameplay/silence. The knowledge firewall stays writer-facing: Torren has not entered occupied Hollow Watch and does not know the garrison fate, excavation goal, hidden descent, buried-structure purpose, or later cartographic significance, but the script should not make him constantly announce those absences. Let omissions, direct observations, wrong guesses if natural, and silence carry uncertainty. Do not name Wayfinder. Do not spend the later cartographic payoff. The Chapter-0 casing is gone; Cyanis carries the intact Card itself and it remains inert.
